structuralInference.candidateRule: allowed when ArmyIds contains JobInfo.Army_ID OR JobIds contains JobInfo.ID; both lists empty means unrestricted
structuralInference.rationale: Explicit JobIds systematically include jobs outside the broad ArmyIds. Treating both lists as an AND condition would make those references unreachable; treating JobIds as additive exact-job exceptions preserves every populated field.
structuralInference.displayNormalization: show ArmyIds as general allowed army types; only JobIds whose JobInfo.Army_ID is outside ArmyIds are non-redundant special-job exceptions; JobIds inside ArmyIds are redundant for display but retained for raw fidelity.
